content: Wufundisaku phangi waku
Muyambenu wuna wukondi ngolu mu lukwikilu, konda kumukumba mu mabanza
Amana kwena yi mutu wenina yi lukwikilu mu kudya bima byosu; kwena yi mutu wahika wuna wena walembwa mu lukwikilu, kisi dya lwesi ndunda.
Wuna wisi dya kalewulaku mutu wuna wisiku dya, amana wuna wisiku dya kafundisaku phi wuna wisi dya, mukuma Nzambi wumuyambini.
Nani wenina ngeyi mu kufundisa musadi wa mukwenu? Kakala watelama holo kakala wabwa, mana matadi pfumu wandi. Amana kazyáma, mukuma Pfumu kenina yi hamu dya kumuzyamisa.
Kikuma, kwena yi mutu, kisi banza ni kilumbu kyaki kiluti kyahika
mu mupfunu, wahika phi kisi banza ni bilumbu byosu byenina mutindu wumosi. Kosu mutu, muna mutindu wa ngangu zandi, kakumbwala muna mamana kisi banza!

Wuna wisi landila mambu matadidini bilumbu kisima landila kikuma kya Pfumu. Wuna wisi dya, kikuma kya Pfumu kisi dila, mukuma matondu kisi vutula kwena Nzambi; Wuna wisiku dya, kikuma kya Pfumu kisiku dila: matondu phi kisi vutula kwena Nzambi.
Kikuma heku mutu, mu kati dya betu, wisi zinga kikuma kya yandi meni, amana heku mutu phi wisi fwa kikuma kya yandi meni.
Mukuma honi thwisi zinga, thwisi zinga kikuma kya Pfumu; amana honi thwisi fwa, thwisi fwa kikuma kya Pfumu. Ata tuzingini, ata tufwini, kaka Pfumu wutuvini.
Mukuma honi Kidisitu kafwa amana wisi hika mu luzingu, ndangu kalenga kala Pfumu wa bafwa yi wa babana babati zinga.
Tuka thama, ngeyi, kikuma kya biki wisi fundisila phangi waku? Holo, ngeyi, kikuma kya biki wisi lewula phangi waku? Kikuma, twatelema betu boosu kuna nganda ya Nzambi.
Mukuma básonika:

content.text: makungulu moosu mafúkama ku thwala meni

content: Yihana ni, kosu mutu kakwenda hana meni dyandi kwena Nzambi kikuma kya yandi meni.
Wubwisisaku phangi waku
Tudifundisakaku baba yi babana; kaasi zengenu ni lukalaku hika kisinza kya kubwisisa phangi wenu holoni kya munata mu kuhanga mbi.
Nzayibwa kyedika, ni mu Pfumu Yesu, kweku kima kya sumuka mu kyawu-meni
; kaasi honi mutu kabanza ni kima kimosi kyenina kya sumuka, kinga kyasumuka kyenina kikuma kya yandi-meni.
Honi kikuma kya madya, phangi waku kenina mu kyadi, wisiku dyatila hika mu mutindu wa lungongu. Kikuma kya madya, wendaku totisa mukwenu yandu kisa fwila Kidisitu.
Yihana ni mambu mena mamboti kwena benu makalaku kima kwa bakwenu kya kukumba.
Kikuma, Kipfumu kya Nzambi, kyeku mu mambu ma kudya yi kunwa; kaasi mena masonga, ngemba yi kyesi, kina kisi hana Kitembu Kyatoma.
Mukuma, kosu mutu wuna wisi musadila Kidisitu muna mutindu meni wuna, Nzambi kisi mumonina kyesi amana batu phi bisi mutya.
Yihana ni, tulandakenu mambu mana misi sadisa mu ngemba yi mana misi tukodisa mu lukwikilu babana yi bakwawu.
Wendaku zanga kisalu kya Nzambi kikuma kya madya. Kyedika, madya moosu menina ma kasemi; kaasi bwenina mbi kwena mutu wuna wubatima dya honi kakitulama kisinza kya kubwila.
Bwenina mboti ni ludyaku mbisi, lunwaku malafu, lusalaku kosu kima kina kyalenda kala kisinza kya kubwila kwena phangi waku.
Lukwikilu luna wenina lwawu, ngeyi, swekalwa kikuma kya ngeyi ku thwala ya Nzambi. Kyesi kwena mutu wuna wisiku difundisa yandi-meni mu mana kabati mona bukheti mu kusala!
Kaasi wuna wisi ketyanisa ho kadya, bisi mubedisa, kikuma mana kabati sala matukiku mu lukwikilu. Kinga moosu mana misiku tuka mu lukwikilu menina masumu.

footnotes.text: Pholu wubanzi tsadidi yina kalonguka kwena Bayuta. Ngalatya 4:10; Khl 2:16
